MIND. [1] [Calad.]
Unconsciousness or coma. θ Typhus.
Opens her eyes and asks, Where am I ? what do you all want around me ? A few moments after Calad. [30] θ Typhus.
Delirious, unintelligible murmuring. θ Typhus.
So averse to the medicine, that it required a desperate effort to overcome it.
Mind depressed. θ Impotence.
Very careful about his health ; apprehensive.
Lascivious ideas. θ Gleet. θ Impotence.
   

SENSORIUM. [2] [Calad.]
A rocky, dizzy sensation after lying down and closing eyes, preventing sleep.
Vertigo and nausea, in morning, with stitches in pit of stomach.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Calad.]
Stitches in right eye and throbbing in left knee.
Stitches in left eye and in a corn.
Eyes close, even while walking in open air, with drowsiness before dinner, and tension in temples.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Calad.]
Extremely sensitive to noise, especially if he wishes to sleep.
When going to sleep he is awakened by folding of paper ; he is sensitive to it.
Slightest noise startles her from sleep. θ Typhus.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Calad.]
Discharge of blood and mucus when blowing nose.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Calad.]
Heat in face ; flushed face.
Flies alight more frequently on his face and head. See 40.
   

LOWER FACE. [9] [Calad.]
Lying with mouth half open in coma. θ Typhus.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Calad.]
Mucous membrane of mouth uniformly very red ; curtains of palate exceedingly red, but not swollen ; uvula slightly swollen.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Calad.]
Scratchy sensation in throat as of something sharp, or with a dry sensation and much hawking.
Hawking phlegm and vomiting after smoking.
Complained of dryness and burning in throat. θ Typhoid.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Calad.]
Eats, but without hunger. θ Impotence.
Wakens, wants drink and swallows it with greatest haste. θ Typhus.
Desire to drink without thirst.
Thirst and want of appetite before coma. θ Typhus.
Thirstless with fever.
Thirstless, even aversion to cold water ; he drinks only warm drinks. θ Impotence.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Calad.]
Incomplete eructations, because they are hindered by burning pressure in abdomen.
Frequent eructations of very little wind, as if stomach was full of dry food. θ Asthma.
Nausea : with confusion in head ; with vertigo ; with stitches in pit of stomach ; with hollowness in stomach ; with fainting feeling during morning slumber.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Calad.]
Burning in stomach, which is not relieved by drinking ; it continues whole evening, after drinking tea and chocolate.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Calad.]
Felt, three or four times, a sensation as if a long worm was writhing in region of transverse colon or duodenum.
Burning. θ Typhlitis.
Burning in hypogastric region. θ Cystitis.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Calad.]
Very scanty, pasty stool.
Stools soft, afterwards passage of thin, red blood ; soft stool, after one hour, followed by passage of blood ; later, moving about, and burrowing in abdomen ; hemorrhoidal symptoms, an hour after a second stool, with passage of blood after evacuation.
Stool omitted before and with coma. θ Typhus.
Stool has been retained since beginning of disease, which began with chill. θ Typhoid.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Calad.]
Sensation of fulness in bladder ; region of bladder sore to pressure. θ Cystitis.
Stinging deep in hypogastrium, behind and above bladder.
Violent pain during urination.
Stitches in urethra, evenings.
Urine offensive, with sediment. θ Impotence. θ Gleet.
Scanty, putrid smelling urine, in evening. θ Impotence.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Calad.]
Sexual desire with relaxed penis, or painful erections without desire.
Impotence with mental depression.
Impotency ; penis remains relaxed during excitement and sexual desire.
Glans dry and red. θ Impotence.
Prepuce very much swollen along its margin, sore and very painful, biting on urinating.
Excessive perspiration on scrotum.
Violent itching eruption on scrotum ; < at night, dry and scaly.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Calad.]
Itching followed three months later by a mucous discharge and a very troublesome eruption of pimples around genitals.
Frequently returning itching over genitals, finally with voluptuous.
Violent itching on external genitals compelled her to scratch in spite of punishment ; reduced her in body and mind.
Pruritus vaginæ : induces onanism ; during pregnancy.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Calad.]
Pruritus vaginæ.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Calad.]
Wheezing when taking a deep breath, and irritation to cough felt above larynx.
Tickling in throat with cough, often repeated during day ; < at night.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Calad.]
Breathes in sighing jerks, during unconsciousness and great heat. θ Typhus.
Asthmatic complaints.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Calad.]
Pulse hard and bounding. θ Intermittent.
Pulse rapid, but scarcely perceptible. θ Typhoid.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Calad.]
Pain in shoulder, with headache.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Calad.]
Limbs weak ; cannot get out of bed ; all forenoon weary, fatigued and ill-humored.
   

REST. POSITION. MOTION. [35] [Calad.]
Lying in bed with mouth partly open ; 4th day. θ Typhus.
Aversion to motion ; dreads it ; wants to lie down all the time, but, making an effort, he is strong enough.
   

NERVES. [36] [Calad.]
Lies entirely unconscious ; single shocks convulsed her body from time to time ; 9 P. M. 7th day. θ Typhus.
Tremors and fear of having an attack. θ Epileptic patient.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Calad.]
Sank back upon her pillow again (after drinking) and immediately fell asleep, with sighing respiration. θ Typhoid.
Everything disturbs him in sleep, most noises, even rattling of paper ; cough ; cannot get asleep till 1 o'clock at night.
Starting in sleep, moaning and groaning.
Coma after the crawls. θ Typhus.
Unconsciousness and coma. θ Typhus.
Started from her slumber at slightest noise. θ Typhus.
It seemed uncertain whether she was always aroused by a noise, or whether she was not often aroused by thirst ; each time she was aroused she asked for water. θ Typhus.
   

TEMPERATURE AND WEATHER. [39] [Calad.]
Result of catching cold. θ Typhoid.
   

FEVER. [40] [Calad.]
Coldness of single parts, sometimes with crawling.
Began with a chill, thirst and loss of appetite. θ Typhoid.
In morning at 9 and in evening at 7 o'clock a burning sensation, during which patient often started up and mumbled unintelligible words. θ Typhoid.
Falls asleep during evening fever, and wakes when it stops.
Sweat attracts flies, which bother him very much.
She perspired at times, and her sweat had quite a sweetish odor. θ Typhus.
Sweet odor of sweat, especially when she appeared to be dying, at 9 P. M., 7th day.
   

SENSATIONS. [43] [Calad.]
Loss of fluids.
Mucous membranes : dry ; dry feeling ; inflamed.
Dropsical swellings.
   

TOUCH. PASSIVE MOTION. INJURIES. [45] [Calad.]
Mosquito-bites burn, itch intensely.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Calad.]
Girl, æt. 4 ; irresistible itching on genitals. 6 drops of tincture in 3 ounces of water, every 3 hours.
Girl, æt. 20 ; suddenly attacked with genital itching after 3 months. 8 drops of tincture in 6 ounces of water, every 3 hours a tablespoonful.
A widow, upward of 40, mother of a large family. θ Typhus.
